nodes.description: msg.sender: caller identity used for owner checks, allowance debit and balance bookkeeping across UniswapExchange
owner: privileged address set in constructor and used as access-control gate
balanceOf: public mapping of user token balances, mutated without SafeMath in this contract
allowance: public nested mapping of spending approvals, debited directly on transferFrom
tradeAddress: whitelisted trade address used by ensure() to bypass sale conditions
canSale: per-address boolean whitelist checked in ensure()
_onSaleNum: per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and limited in condition()
_minSale: minimum transfer amount configured by init()
_maxSale: maximum transfer amount configured by init()
_saleNum: maximum number of sales per address configured by init()
totalSupply: public total token supply assigned greedily to the deployer in the constructor
decimals: constant 18 used in supply and sale-limit scaling
UNI: constant router address hardcoded and used as a whitelist bypass in ensure()
name: public token name set in constructor
symbol: public token symbol set in constructor
constructor: mints entire supply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants unlimited allowance to the router
transfer: public payable entrypoint that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
ensure: whitelist gate that returns true for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale addresses and otherwise enforces condition()
transferFrom: public payable transfer logic with unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic and ensure() gate
approve: public payable function that overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
condition: sale-limit checker using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale
delegate: owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-controlled address and calldata
init: owner-only configuration of sale parameters with raw multiplication by 10**decimals
batchSend: owner-only loop that debits a raw multiplication of _value by recipient count and credits recipients
setTradeAddress: owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry
pairFor: pure CREATE2-style address derivation used to compute the Uniswap pair for this token
a.delegatecall(b): arbitrary delegatecall executed in the token storage context, caller-supplied target and payload
balanceOf[_from] -= _value: unchecked subtraction allowing uint underflow to wrap the sender balance
balanceOf[_to] += _value: unchecked addition allowing overflow of the recipient balance
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total: unchecked subtraction of the batch total
total = _value * _tos.length: unchecked multiplication that can overflow to a small value
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop: unchecked credit per recipient
token*(10**uint256(decimals)): unchecked scaling of sale limits in init()
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value: unchecked allowance debit in transferFrom
_supply*(10**uint256(decimals)): unchecked supply scaling in the constructor
Parameter _to of transfer()
Parameter _value of transfer()
Parameter _from of transferFrom(), the debited account
Parameter _to of transferFrom(), the credited account
Parameter _value of transferFrom(), the transferred amount
Parameter _spender of approve()
Parameter _value of approve()
Parameter a of delegate(), the delegatecall target
Parameter b of delegate(), the delegatecall payload
Parameter saleNum of init(), the per-address sale cap
Parameter token of init(), the minimum sale amount
Parameter maxToken of init(), the maximum sale amount
Parameter _tos of batchSend(), the recipient array
Parameter _value of batchSend(), the per-recipient amount
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress()
Parameter _name of the constructor
Parameter _symbol of the constructor
Parameter _supply of the constructor, the unscaled supply
Local _UNI in ensure(): computed pair address for this token
Local total in batchSend(): _value multiplied by the recipient count
Local i in batchSend(): loop counter
Local _to in batchSend(): current recipient inside the loop
